messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — running an emergency drill tomorrow to exercise snapshot decrypts + RBAC edgecases after last week's CMK roll. Goal: restore a small read-only snapshot and verify audit coverage. Plan: ephemeral grant -> restore -> audit queries.

Jorge P: 👍 what time?

Maya R: 10:30am PST, ~30m. Staging first, then a non-data prod-sim. We'll use a test CMK but replay prod mapping logic.

Anna L: Don't touch prod CMK; simulate mapping only.

Samir K: I'll provide an ephemeral grant helper. Example: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-backup-test --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-restore-staging --operations Decrypt --constraints 'EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"restore-drill"}'
```
I will auto-retire after 5m.

Kevin H: CloudTrail sometimes lags. Check for kms:Decrypt and kms:RetireGrant, plus s3:GetObject with SSE headers. Run a follow-up check 2m later.

Maya R: Query plan: Athena for s3:GetObject where requestParameters contains serverSideEncryption, and CloudTrail eventName="Decrypt".

Anna L: Also check sts:AssumeRole success events — we had mapping drift earlier that caused implicit deny.

Jorge P: Can we test policy matrix: policy present (expect success), policy removed (expect deny + audit), grant expired (expect KMS denied error)?

Maya R: Yes — matrix will be A) policy attached, B) policy removed, C) grant expired. We'll capture expected event names for each.

Samir K: Note: multipart restores can strip SSE headers. Use single-part small snapshot to keep telemetry clear.

encops-bot: Reminder: scheduled drill: 2024-06-15T17:30:00Z. Acknowledge if on-call.

Kevin H: I'll monitor CloudTrail + SIEM. Ad-hoc Splunk query ready: index=cloudtrail eventName=("Decrypt" OR "RetireGrant" OR "GetObject") | stats count by eventName, userIdentity.arn

Anna L: I'll run the restore step and RBAC smoke tests. If unexpected 403s appear we pause.

Maya R: Checklist: 1) create ephemeral grant (Samir) 2) upload test snapshot (Maya) 3) run restore (Anna) 4) verify CloudTrail/Athena (Kevin) 5) retire grant & verify RetireGrant logs (Samir) 6) collect logs & postmortem (Maya). Correlation tag: drill-1717432100.

Jorge P: Ops note: use alias/redwood-backup-test-<runid> to avoid alias rotation collisions.

Maya R: If anyone sees cleartext uploads or missing SSE metadata, stop and notify sec-oncall. I'll post postmortem stub at /docs/encops/drills/snapshot-keystore-drill-2024-06.md after the run. ✅
